Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 529 BNSS has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide the Criminal Case No.972A of 1994 (State Vs. Vinod and others) arising out of case crime no.454 of 1993 under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Mawana, District Meerut, pending in the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Mawana, Meerut expeditiously within a stipulated period.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.972A of 1994 (State Vs. Vinod and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant before this Court is the accused in this case.
The case pertains to the year 1994 and is still pending since long.

It is also submitted that earlier an Application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. No. - 33388 of 2022 was moved before this Court by the present applicant which was disposed of vide order dated 13.1.2023 directing the trial court to complete the proceedings of this case within one month but however the said case is still pending and the order of this Court was not complied with by the learned trial court.
Naeem Ahmed vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 4 June, 2025

entities.text: Naeem Ahmed vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
5. In the circumstances, the trial court is cautioned and it must always be vigilant to ensure the compliance of the order of this Court.

Further, the trial court is directed to conclude/decide the matter within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it in accordance with law and in the light of the order passed by this Court on 13.1.2023 mentioned hereinabove, provided the applicant cooperates with the trial court.

6. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.

7. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 4.6.2025 ss  Naeem Ahmed vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169195999/
